Package com.animationlib.api

package com.animationlib.api
Public API of animationlib. Classes here are the stable surface other mods should depend on; anything under com.animationlib.impl may change without notice.

    com.animationlib.impl

  • Class
    Description
    Animation
    A named, reusable handle to an animation resource: configured once, then played as often as you like.
    AnimationData
    A parsed animation: its loop flag, length in seconds, and per-bone keyframe channels.
    AnimationPlayer
    Plays a loaded animation on an entity.
    AnimationRegistry
    Read-only access to animations loaded from assets/<namespace>/animationlib/animations/, populated automatically on resource reload.
    BoneAnimation
    The animated channels for a single bone.
    BoneChannel
    The keyframes for one transform channel (rotation, position, or scale) of a bone.
    Keyframe
    A single keyframe on a BoneChannel.
    Vec3f
    A rotation/position/scale triple, as used by Blockbench/Bedrock animation keyframes.
